our_takes.our-take: The DBS Esso Card gives up to 23% savings on fuel at Esso, appealing to frequent drivers. Achieving the maximum savings requires a minimum S$160 nett fuel spend each month. While you earn Smiles points on other retail spend, the card's main value lies in fuel discounts. Consider if your driving habits justify the spend requirement to maximize savings. The high interest rates and foreign transaction fees make it less attractive for balances or overseas use.
our_takes.good-for:
* Car owners who frequently refuel at Esso stations and want to maximize fuel savings through discounts.
* Individuals who want to earn rewards on everyday spending and redeem them for fuel or other perks.
* Singaporeans or PRs earning at least S$30,000 annually who prioritize fuel savings and enjoy contactless payments.
our_takes.things-to-note:
- Annual fees of S$196.20 apply after the first year; evaluate if card benefits justify the cost.
- Interest rates are high at 27.8% p.a., plus 3% more if minimum payment is not made.
- Balance transfers and cash withdrawals have high fees: 8% or S$15, avoid if possible.
